title.zh: 伦理框架 · 后果、权利、公平与同意
title.en: Ethical frameworks · consequences, rights, fairness and consent

description.zh: 同一个决定换一套框架就会问不同的问题：结果主义问总后果好不好，权利框架问有没有越过不可侵犯的边界，公平框架问代价是否落在某一群人身上，同意则问当事人是否知情、能否拒绝——把这些问题分开写，取舍才看得清。
description.en: Under different frameworks the same decision raises different questions: consequentialism asks whether the overall outcome is good, a rights framework whether an inviolable line is crossed, a fairness framework whether the costs fall on one group, and consent whether those affected are informed and free to refuse — writing these out separately makes the trade-offs visible.

en: how to make an ethical judgment

label.en: Writing consequences as an expected value

reason.zh: 结果主义的计算常写成 E = p·benefit − (1−p)·harm；它能比较后果，却不会自动回答同意、尊严或分配的问题。
reason.en: Consequentialist reckoning is often written E = p·benefit − (1−p)·harm; it compares outcomes, but does not by itself settle consent, dignity or distribution.

label.zh: 公平框架的一个思想实验
label.en: A thought experiment for the fairness lens

reason.zh: 无知之幕让选择规则的人不知道自己会落在哪个位置，从而逼着他像关心自己一样关心最差的位置，是检验“代价是否公平分摊”的一个工具。
reason.en: The veil of ignorance hides from rule-makers which position they will occupy, forcing them to care about the worst position as if it were their own — a tool for testing whether costs are shared fairly.
